title.original: The Anatomy of a Triton Attention Kernel
title.en: The Anatomy of a Triton Attention Kernel

inclusion_reason.zh: 该 Triton 实现连同自动调优和推理服务接口提供跨 NVIDIA/AMD 的可移植分页注意力执行层。
inclusion_reason.en: The Triton implementation, autotuning, and serving interface provide a portable paged-attention execution layer across NVIDIA and AMD.

abstract.zh: 该工作用纯 Triton 实现跨 NVIDIA 与 AMD 的高性能分页注意力，并总结算法重构、系统优化、参数自动调优和推理服务集成的完整路径。
abstract.en: This work builds a high-performance paged-attention kernel entirely in Triton for NVIDIA and AMD GPUs and documents the algorithmic changes, system optimizations, autotuning, and serving integration needed.

problem.zh: 分页注意力通常依赖厂商特定手写 kernel；通用 DSL 虽可移植，却常因内存布局、调度参数和服务接口不匹配而性能落后。
problem.en: Paged attention usually relies on vendor-specific handwritten kernels; portable DSL code often lags because memory layout, launch parameters, and serving integration are not jointly optimized.

approach.zh: 作者逐步改造 Triton 算法和数据路径，加入关键系统级优化，并自动搜索硬件相关参数，最后将 kernel 集成到实际推理服务器。
approach.en: The authors iteratively restructure the Triton algorithm and data path, add system-level optimizations, autotune hardware-dependent parameters, and integrate the result into a production inference server.

system_design.zh: 统一 Triton 源码通过 JIT 针对不同 GPU 编译，自动调优器选择块和并行配置，分页 KV 接口连接服务端批处理与内核执行。
system_design.en: One Triton source is JIT-compiled for each GPU, an autotuner selects tiling and parallel settings, and a paged-KV interface links server batching to kernel execution.

key_results.zh: 经过联合优化后，通用 Triton kernel 从明显落后提升到与厂商优化实现相当甚至略优，并在两家 GPU 平台保持可移植性。
key_results.en: After joint optimization, the generic Triton kernel moves from a large deficit to parity or slight advantage over vendor-tuned implementations across both GPU vendors.

limitations.zh: 高性能仍依赖每种硬件和形状的自动调优，编译与搜索成本不可忽略；结论集中于分页注意力，不能直接外推到全部推理算子。
limitations.en: Performance still depends on per-hardware and per-shape autotuning with nontrivial compile cost; evidence centers on paged attention and does not automatically extend to all inference operators.

metrics.name: Final performance relative to state of the art

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
